errors.evidence: The description does not mention the shaded areas around each line, which represent error bands or variance.
The x-axis tick labels range from 0.6 to 1.4, while the data points range from 0.5 to 1.5. The stated range of 0.6 to 1.5 is an inaccurate combination of these.
The tick labels on the x-axis are at regular intervals of 0.2 (0.6, 0.8, 1.0, 1.2, 1.4), not irregular.
The starting value for the pink line (MATTER) at x=0.5 is approximately 55.0%, not 55.5%.
The ending value for the purple line (w/o material information) at x=1.5 is clearly below the 48% grid line (approximately 47.9%). The stated value of 48.5% is incorrect.
